mentions.name: Parquet Viewer for macOS
mentions.description: This is a macOS application for viewing Parquet files, integrating with Finder Preview so users can preview Parquet files directly from Finder. It is planned for release on the macOS App Store before the end of February.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm writing a Parquet (file format) viewer for macOS with Finder Preview. Will definitely release in the macOS app store before end of February.
